new_src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        nonbg = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not nonbg:
            continue
        last = nonbg[-1]
        color = row[last]
        start = last
        while start > 0 and row[start - 1] == color:
            start -= 1
        if last - start + 1 >= 2 and last + 1 < len(row):
            out[r][last + 1] = 1
    return out
'''

def candidate_transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    supports=[[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg] for row in grid]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        si=supports[i]
        if not si: continue
        opts=[]
        for j,other in enumerate(grid):
            sj=supports[j]
            if len(sj)<=len(si): continue
            if all(other[c]==row[c] for c in si):
                # comparable rows: all other differences must be missing cells, and require a reasonable overlap
                diff=[c for c in range(len(row)) if row[c]!=other[c]]
                if len(diff)<=len(row)//2:
                    opts.append((len(diff),j,diff))
        if opts:
            _,j,diff=min(opts)
            for c in diff: out[i][c]=1
    return out

src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    supports = [[c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg] for row in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        support = supports[i]
        if not support:
            continue
        candidates = []
        for j, other in enumerate(grid):
            if len(supports[j]) <= len(support):
                continue
            if all(other[c] == row[c] for c in support):
                differing = [c for c in range(len(row)) if row[c] != other[c]]
                if len(differing) <= len(row) // 2:
                    candidates.append((len(differing), differing))
        if candidates:
            _, differing = min(candidates)
            for c in differing:
                out[i][c] = 1
    return out
'''
